objective: Strategie de Momentum sur TRUMPUSDC 15m. Indicateurs : EMA(20), ATR. Calculer la pente de EMA(20) via np.diff. Entree long quand la pente est positive et accelere. Stop-loss = 1.5x ATR, take-profit = 3.0x ATR.

iterations.hypothesis: Using EMA(20) slope as a momentum filter ensures we only enter in the direction of the prevailing trend, while ATR-based risk management provides dynamic stop-loss and take-profit levels that scale with volatility, reducing false signals and improving risk-reward ratios in the TRUMPUSDC 15m timeframe.
